Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual ops playbook: scenario lattice & OKR gap assessment

Team —

Kicking off a lightweight playbook to structure annual planning work across product, eng, GTM, and infra. Goal: give the execs a crisp set of scenarios and a prioritized set of asks for the QBR in 4 weeks. I sketched a first pass (attached). High-level asks: 

- Synthesize OKR gaps (team-level -> company-level) and highlight where we either need more investment or a scope pullback.
- Produce three budget/staffing scenarios: Conservative (cost-first), Base (status-quo), Growth (opportunity capture).
- For each scenario, include critical hires (role, month of ramp), unit cost delta, and two contingency triggers.
- Timeline: pre-read by 2026-06-17, working session week of 6/22, final QBR packet by 7/8.

Please review the attached playbook and the staffing model draft. Quick asks for this week: add your team’s top 3 OKR gaps inline in the doc and flag any hires that are non-negotiable. I’ll consolidate and circulate a one-pager for exec review.

Attachments: [Attachment: playbook_v0.1.pdf (PDF, 470KB)], [Attachment: staffing_model_drafts.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

Thanks —
Marcus
VP, Platform & Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual ops playbook: scenario lattice & OKR gap assessment

Marcus —

Appreciate the structure. Two asks from my side: 

1) Please surface the critical hires first (by role and month) — we need a short list of "must-fill" vs "nice-to-have" so Finance can simulate the cash impact quickly.
2) Add ramp timelines and expected time-to-impact for each hire (e.g., 0-3 months: onboarding only, 3-6 months: measurable feature/throughput contribution). If we can attach a simple FTE-to-revenue/cost metric that would speed approvals.

On contingency triggers: include a very short set of measurable signals (e.g., 10% drop in avg response latency, MRR slip of X) that flip us between scenarios.

I'll ask Strategy to prioritize a headcount run with two FTE phasing options.

—Vivek
SVP, Product & GTM
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marcus — this is a solid start. A couple of pragmatic notes: 

- Execs want a single-page "asks & impacts" stretch for the QBR. Please make sure the consolidated deliverable includes (1) what we are asking for, (2) the business impact, and (3) the fallback if we don't get the investment.
- Can we lock a pre-read deadline of 2026-06-17 COB? I want org leads to sign off before the working session.
- On staffing: call out any hires that require external recruiting partners — those take longer.

If possible, Marcus, can you include a one-line ask per leader (e.g., "Eng: 3 ICs for model infra by Sep - ask for 3 FTE") so I can pull that into a short slide.

Forwarding my notes — I added a short risk register and a worst-case runbook sketch. See inline comments in the attached CSV. 

Top items I flagged: 
- Capacity risk if we delay infra hires beyond Q3. Point estimate: 12% increase in per-token latency under growth scenario.
- Contracting/renewal timing for a major partner in September; that swings revenue in Growth case.
- Ops coverage for on-call + paging increases with additional model endpoints — may need +1 SRE in the Base case.

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Short summary and action items: 

Decisions made:
- We will prepare the Base and Growth scenarios for the QBR packet; Conservative will be maintained as an appendix.
- Critical hires (must-fill): 2x Model Infra ICs (target start Aug), 1x Senior SRE (target start Jul). Finance will run the two-phasing FTE model Vivek requested.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- All leads: add top 3 OKR gaps + hire asks into the Notion playbook (link below) by 2026-06-17 COB.
- Finance (Lauren & Rachel): produce a headcount cost delta by 2026-06-18.
- Strategy (Jonas): send calendar invite for working session (confirmed 2026-06-22 10:00 PT).
- Ops (Marissa): finalize risk register and worst-case runbook by 2026-06-18.
- Marcus: consolidate one-pager and circulate to Exec team for pre-read on 2026-06-21.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3-playbook-drafts, https://www.notion.so/redwood/Annual-Planning-Playbook-Overview-ef12ab34

Attachments referenced: playbook_v0.1.pdf, staffing_model_drafts.xlsx, risk_register.csv

If anyone has escalation items (procurement hurdles, hiring blockers, partner dependencies) please raise them in-thread or ping me directly. I'll take ownership of the consolidated one-pager.
